title: BE STILL AND REST
A BEDTIME PRAYER
end: The Secret Place — prayers every day

scenes.a: Take a slow, deep breath, release the tension of your day, and let the quiet of this night settle over your heart.
The Word of God reminds us in Psalm 37:7, Be still before the Lord and wait patiently for him.
Lord, as I lie down tonight, I surrender every anxious thought, unfinished task, and hidden fear into your loving hands.
Calm my restless mind, quiet my soul, and wrap this room in the warmth of your unbreakable, holy peace.
Watch over me through the shadows of the night, trusting that you are continuously working all things for my good.
Sleep peacefully in His embrace tonight. Subscribe to rest in God's presence with us every single night.
